Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000327": The catalog service's joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000324" [decision]: On 2025-04-04, Team Dune agreed that the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000317": As of 2025-04-04, the notifier lives with Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, notifier)
- memory_id "1000314": Team Boreal kept the notifier until 2025-04-04.  (about: Team Boreal, notifier)
- memory_id "1000268": As of 2025-03-24, Farah still has the Team Dune pager.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000266" [constraint]: The catalog service ships only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000259": Team Dune owns the catalog service as of the 2025-03-20 ownership transfer.  (about: Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000255": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000201": Team Cinder holds planning on Mondays.  (about: Team Cinder)
- memory_id "1000198": The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents.  (about: catalog service, indexer)
- memory_id "1000178": Team Cinder observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and flagged it since it is not their service.  (about: Team Cinder, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000174": On 2025-02-21, Yuki handed the Team Cinder pager to Diego during rotation day.  (about: Team Cinder, Yuki, Diego)
- memory_id "1000168" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000150": INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000123": The resizer lives with Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, resizer)
- memory_id "1000114": The notifier depends on the event bus for delivery events.  (about: event bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000108": The indexer lives with Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000098": Farah takes the first on-call rotation for Team Dune.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000090": Yuki takes the first Team Cinder on-call shift of the year.  (about: Team Cinder, Yuki)
- memory_id "1000021": Team Cinder consists of Yuki and Diego.  (about: Team Cinder, Yuki, Diego)
Existing entity names: catalog service, Team Dune, Team Cinder, notifier, Team Boreal, Farah, indexer, auth gateway, Yuki, Diego, push provider, INC-2025-004, resizer, event bus
